run_doctor_main: run the DeerFlow health check main entry point to verify system and configuration status
check_python_version: check that the Python version meets the 3.12+ requirement
check_node_version: check that Node.js version meets the 22+ requirement
check_config_yaml: check that config.yaml exists, is loadable, and models are configured
check_llm_api_keys: check that LLM API environment variables referenced in config.yaml are set
check_sandbox_config: check sandbox configuration including local and container sandbox modes
check_web_search_tool: check web search tool configuration and API key availability
check_web_fetch_tool: check web fetch tool configuration and API key availability
create_CheckResult: create a CheckResult object with label, status, detail, and optional fix instructions
review_check_sandbox: review the check_sandbox function that validates sandbox configuration and bash compatibility
